keywords: Verification process 2.Problem solving process 3.Basic skills for verification activities 4.Data science 5.Science and engineering PBL
educationalGoal: -To gain the basic skills needed in processes from finding problems to solutions. -To understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively. -To be able to find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objectives, and events. -To be able to deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly. -To gain various basic skills to proceed smoothly with verification activities. -To be able to have a picture of technology fields and engineers of discipline.
advice: ・In this course, students learn the basic skills required for inspection and problem-solving in order to achieve the above learning objectives. ・This course focuses on the distinctive experiments of the department of mechanical engineering. ・Students learn the basic skills of data science required to collect, organize, analyze, hypothesize, visualize, and report data. ・Students learn the basic skills of project-based learning for engineering including the process for problem discovery skills, problem-solving skills and inspection skills. ・In the guidance, students understand how to proceed with class, precautions, and how to use classrooms and laboratories. In addition, students will learn awareness and actions for the safety experiments by attending a safety seminar. ・Students learn how to communicate to visualize their thoughts or the contents of their reports. ・Students learn about experimental equipment and units, and learn how to evaluate experimental results. ・Students work on different experimental themes every week. ・Students collect a wide range of knowledge and information necessary to organize the results of the experiments, and make a report based on the information. ・Students present the experimental results using posters or PowerPoint.
requiredKnowledge: We advise students to become engineers who think and act on their own initiative. Students should actively ask questions about things that they don't understand, but should have their own thoughts in advance. For the collection of information, students will collect information for the purpose of the experiment by utilizing library centers, etc. It is necessary to master how to use a personal computer and a network printer.

activityGoals.body: To be able to proceed with activities from finding problems to solutions.
To be able to understand phenomena, objects, and events quantitatively and qualitatively.
To be able to find characteristics, features, and laws of phenomena, objects, and events.
To be able to deliver acquired information to a third person intelligibly.
To be able to utilize various basic skills needed to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
To be able to have a picture of the technology fields and engineers of the discipline.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1) To be able to proceed with activities from problem-finding to solution. 2) To be able to quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events based on data science. 3) To be able to recognize characteristics and regularities of corresponding phenomena, objects, and events. 4) To be able to communicate acquired information to a third person intelligibly. 5) To be able to smoothly conduct verification activities independently. 6) To be able to recognize the identity of the major (department) and be proud.
achievementLevels.standard: 1) To be able to proceed with activities from problem-finding to solution with guidance by instructor. 2) To be able to quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events based on data science with guidance. 3) To be able to recognize characteristics and regularities of phenomena, objects, and events with guidance. 4) To be able to communicate acquired information to a third person. 5) To be able to conduct verification activities with guidance. 6) To be able to recognize the identity of the major (department) and be proud with guidance.
